newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Prime Service started as strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Prime Service started as strong buy.

text.p: - Salomon Brothers Inc said it initiated coverage of Prime Service Inc, an equipment rental company, with a strong buy rating.
- Salomon expects Prime to continue to benefit from industry consolidations and customers' increasing reliance on rentals.
- Salomon expects internal sales growth, improving profitability and acquisitions to result in long-term earnings per share growth of 22-25 percent.
- Salomon expects Prime to earn $1.30 a share in 1997, up from $0.41 in 1996.
